name: Hostage Heart
source:
You're a junior bank employee on what should have been a routine shift. Then a group of masked robbers storms the bank, their guns raised.

Their leader is a girl with a face mask, black hoodie, and vacant eyes. She looks your manager in the eye and makes one demand.

"You have one hour to bring me Adrien Crowe, or this building explodes."

To survive, you will have to choose your words carefully. Earn the robber's trust, seek help from your policewoman ex, or play both sides long enough to uncover why this is happening at all.

Because the girl in the hood is not just another criminal. You recognise her voice.

[From [url=https://tenshistudios.itch.io/hostage-heart]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你只是一名初级银行职员，今天原本该是一次再寻常不过的值班。然而一群蒙面劫匪突然端着枪冲进了银行大厅。

劫匪头目是一名戴着口罩、身穿黑色连帽衫、眼神空洞的女孩。她直视着银行经理的眼睛，只提出了一个要求：

“给你们一小时把阿德里安·克劳带到我面前，否则整栋楼都会炸上天。”

为了活命，你必须字斟句酌、谨慎开口。是设法博取劫匪的信任，向身为女警的前女友暗中求援，还是在双方之间左右逢源、拖延足够长的时间，好查明这一切背后的真正缘由？

因为那个穿着连帽衫的女孩绝非寻常罪犯——你认得她的声音。

[摘自[url=https://tenshistudios.itch.io/hostage-heart]itch.io[/url]]
